# Building

Builds use the pinned toolchain and prepared upstream source identities recorded
under `toolchains/` and `integrations/`. Network access is disabled after exact
upstream preparation.

## Local Workflow

Generate canonical projections before verification. Use changed-path or Fast
verification during development, then the canonical Full graph for a phase exit.
Package qualification uses independent A/B assemblies and requires byte
identity before an artifact can be frozen.

## Generated Files

Change canonical authorities rather than editing generated output. Hybrid
documentation is the exception only inside declared generated-block markers;
reviewed prose outside those markers is protected.
